name: HaluEval 2.0
description: HaluEval 2.0 is a benchmark designed to evaluate hallucination detection in large language models (LLMs). It focuses on assessing the factuality hallucination problem by providing data for detection, analyzing sources of hallucination, and testing mitigation techniques.
reputation: A recent hallucination-detection benchmark that has gained attention as part of the growing effort to measure factuality and hallucination mitigation in LLMs.
notes: Focuses on hallucination detection, source analysis, and mitigation in LLMs; includes a new benchmark and a detection method.
